summary: Crash after attempting to move item from off-hand in Creative inventory
description: A crash is caused when trying to offhand an item in the creative inventory after attempting to do so in the search tab Steps to reproduce: - Have an item in your off-hand in creative mode - Open inventory and go to the Search tab - Use the off-hand key to try and put the item in your off-hand into the hotbar (stopped as the search box takes priority) - Change back to the Survival Inventory tab, and then press the off-hand key again without hovering cursor over any inventory slots or: - Have an item in your off-hand in creative mode - Hover over any empty slot in a tab other than Survival Inventory - Select the Survival Inventory tab, and then press the off-hand key without hovering cursor over any inventory slots As far as I can tell (Not a programmer or anything, didn t look at code, just from my small testing) this happens because the offhand hotkey when pressed tries to put the item in your offhand into the last inventory slot that you had "selected" (hovered over) with your cursor. When you try to use the offhand hotkey when under the search tab, the search box takes priority and types instead of allowing you to offhand, making it the last selected inventory "slot" (I believe,) when you change back to your player inventory tab, there s no textbox anymore, so when you try to use the hotkey again, the game crashes as there s no "last selected" slot to offhand to (or maybe because it tries to offhand to the textbox? I dunno I m not a programmer) Simply hovering over an inventory slot after swapping to the player inventory before using the offhand hotkey will prevent the crash and allow the hotkey to work as normal.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft in Creative mode.
2. Ensure an item is in your off-hand.
3. Open the inventory and navigate to the Search tab.
4. Attempt to move the item from your off-hand into the hotbar using the off-hand key.
5. Change to the Survival Inventory tab.
6. Without hovering your cursor over any inventory slots, press the off-hand key again.
7. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: The bug occurs when a player attempts to use the off-hand key to move an item from the off-hand to the hotbar while in the Creative inventory, specifically after interacting with the search tab. When the player has an item in their off-hand and opens the inventory to the search tab, pressing the off-hand key does not transfer the item as expected because the search box takes priority for text input. This results in the search box becoming the last selected slot. Upon switching back to the Survival Inventory tab and pressing the off-hand key again without hovering over any inventory slots, the game crashes. This crash seems to occur because there is no valid last selected inventory slot to transfer the item to, as the search box is no longer present. Alternatively, if the player hovers over an empty slot in a different tab and then selects the Survival Inventory tab, pressing the off-hand key again without hovering over any slots also leads to a crash. However, if the player hovers over a valid inventory slot in the player inventory tab before using the off-hand key, the crash is prevented, and the hotkey functions normally.
Expected Behavior: When attempting to move an item from the off-hand to the hotbar in Creative mode, the game should allow the player to successfully transfer the item without crashing. Pressing the off-hand key while in the Survival Inventory tab should function normally, enabling the item to be placed in the hotbar as expected. The game should maintain stability and not produce any errors, regardless of the previous interactions with the inventory tabs.
